title: Slime Cube
description:
Slime Cubes allow Slimes to spawn in the Chunk they are in. Unlike Vanilla Slime Chunks Slimes can spawn at any height.
Powered by Redstone this block instead prevents slimes from spawning through vanilla spawning mechanics (Slime Chunk / Swampland)

This also applies to mobs from spawners, but not to mobs spawned with spawn eggs.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Crafted; may be found in dungeon chests (10%) and jungle temple chests (80%)

properties.label: Redstone
properties.value: Unpowered allows slime spawns in its chunk; powered stops them

properties.label: Config
properties.value: SlimeCube (loot), default true - turns chest loot off
